biggest_gap.title: In Arabic, the audit log's 'Changed by' filter cannot find a person by their own full name: the exact match is ranked below the 10 options shown, and the first option is a different person
biggest_gap.detail: The round is BLOCKED only because neither full verify passed every test, and neither failure is in p07's code (see hard_gates). The product gap that most holds p07 back is filtering by user, one of the filters the spec requires, for a user working in Arabic. The person search answers users whose name contains the text, sorted alphabetically by English display name (IdentityModule.SearchAsync: OrderBy(u => u.DisplayName)). The picker asks for 10 (AuditLogPage.tsx: /api/audit/actors?take=10). In a workspace with many people whose names contain the typed name, the person asked for never appears. Typing 'مريم المنصوري' exactly puts Mariam Al Mansoori (the administrator) 20th of 20 answers. The first options are 'عائشة مريم المنصوري', 'أنيل مريم المنصوري' and so on. Choosing the first option by keyboard filters the log to someone else, and the screen shows 'no changes'. In English the same person is first, because 'Al Mansoori' differs from the dataset's 'Al Mansouri'. 'فاطمة الزعابي' and 'Fatima Al Zaabi' rank 4th. A first name alone ('Mariam', 'Fatima') never shows the person. Round 6 reported the same ranking, and it is unchanged. For a UAE company, where many staff share family and given names, 'what did this person change' is the auditor's daily question. Fix: rank an exact name (English or Arabic) first, then names that start with the text, then contains-matches, and debounce the picker. Today it sends one request per keystroke.
biggest_gap.evidence: attack/actors-rank.mjs, run as admin.ar@alnoor.example against the demo seeded with the comparison dataset (100,000 users). Output attack/actors-rank.out: '"مريم المنصوري" answers 20 exact at 19 | first 4: عائشة مريم المنصوري/Aisha Mariam Al Mansouri, ...' and '"Fatima Al Zaabi" answers 20 exact at 3'. The options list starts with عائشة مريم المنصوري, the chip reads 'بواسطة يساوي عائشة مريم المنصوري', and the result is 'لا تغييرات' (screenshot ar-05-a-changed-by.jpg). The English run, walk7-en.out, narrows 760,211 rows to 28, then 3, then 1.
